title: Sicherheitskooperation (SiKoop) der Länder führt gemeinsame Aktionswoche gegen Straftaten zum Nachteil von älteren Menschen (SÄM) durch

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin and four other German states launch a joint action week from 29 June to 5 July 2026 against crimes targeting older people, including fraud and distraction theft. Police Berlin are offering more than 40 prevention events citywide.
